message.content:
Below is a quick‑reference guide to the most common “tools” (websites, mobile apps, APIs, and software platforms) you can use to search for, compare, and book flights.  I’ve grouped them by category so you can pick the right one for your workflow—whether you’re a casual traveler, a travel‑agent, or a developer building a flight‑booking feature.

| Category | Tool / Platform | What it offers | Typical use‑case |
|----------|-----------------|----------------|------------------|
| **Consumer‑facing booking sites** | **Google Flights** | Fast search, price alerts, multi‑city itineraries | Quick price comparison, exploring routes |
| | **Skyscanner** | Aggregates many airlines & OTAs, “Everywhere” search | Budget travelers, flexible dates |
| | **Kayak** | Price alerts, price forecast, “Explore” feature | Planning trips, monitoring price trends |
| | **Momondo** | Deep‑search across airlines & OTAs, price history | Finding hidden deals |
| | **Expedia** | Flights + hotels + car rentals, package deals | One‑stop booking, loyalty points |
| | **Priceline** | “Name Your Own Price”, Express Deals | Last‑minute or discounted fares |
| | **Orbitz** | Similar to Expedia, with Orbitz Rewards | Frequent traveler rewards |
| | **Hotwire** | “Hot Rate” for discounted flights | Budget travelers, last‑minute |
| | **Hopper** | Predictive pricing, mobile app | Mobile‑first travelers, price alerts |
| | **Trip.com / Ctrip** | Strong presence in Asia, multi‑currency | International travelers, Asian routes |
| | **Airbnb Experiences** (flight‑booking partner) | Bundled experiences + flights | Experiential travel |
| **Airline‑direct booking** | **United Airlines, Delta, American, etc.** | Direct seat selection, frequent‑flyer integration | Loyalty program benefits |
| | **Low‑cost carriers** (Ryanair, Southwest, JetBlue, AirAsia, etc.) | Direct booking, no‑frills | Budget travelers |
| **Travel‑agency / corporate tools** | **Sabre** | Global Distribution System (GDS) for agencies | Enterprise booking, inventory access |
| | **Amadeus** | GDS + API for travel tech | Travel agencies, OTA developers |
| | **Travelport** | GDS, API, and travel‑tech solutions | Corporate travel, travel agencies |
| | **Concur** | Corporate travel management | Business travel, expense integration |
| | **Egencia** | Corporate travel platform | Corporate travel, policy enforcement |
| **Developer APIs** | **Amadeus for Developers** | Flight search, booking, price alerts | Build custom booking widgets |
| | **Skyscanner Flights API** | Search, price alerts, flight availability | Integrate into apps or websites |
| | **Google Flights API** (via Google Travel API) | Flight search, price insights | Data‑driven travel apps |
| | **Sabre APIs** | Flight search, booking, inventory | Enterprise travel tech |
| | **Travelport APIs** | Flight, hotel, car, package booking | Travel agencies, OTAs |
| | **OpenSky API** | Real‑time flight data (not booking) | Flight tracking, analytics |
| | **FlightAware API** | Flight status, tracking | Status updates, flight‑tracking apps |
| | **FlightStats API** | Flight status, delays, historical data | Analytics, travel apps |
| | **AirLabs API** | Flight search, price alerts | Travel tech startups |
| | **FlightRadar24 API** | Real‑time flight tracking | Tracking, aviation apps |
| | **OpenFlights API** | Airport & airline data | Data enrichment |
| **Mobile apps** | **Google Flights** | iOS/Android | Quick searches on the go |
| | **Skyscanner** | iOS/Android | Price alerts, multi‑city |
| | **Hopper** | iOS/Android | Predictive pricing, booking |
| | **Kayak** | iOS/Android | Alerts, price forecasts |
| | **Expedia** | iOS/Android | Package deals, loyalty |
| | **Airbnb** | iOS/Android | Flights + experiences |
| | **TripIt** | iOS/Android | Trip organization, flight reminders |
| | **FlightAware** | iOS/Android | Real‑time flight status |
| | **FlightRadar24** | iOS/Android | Live flight tracking |
| **Other niche tools** | **Momondo** | Deep‑search, price history | Finding best deals |
| | **Google Travel** | Trip planning, flight + hotel | All‑in‑one planning |
| | **Trip.com** | Strong in Asia, multi‑currency | International travelers |
| | **Travelpayouts** | Affiliate flight booking | Monetization for travel blogs |
| | **Skiplagged** | Hidden‑city ticketing (controversial) | Cost‑saving for savvy travelers |

### How to choose

| Need | Recommended tool(s) |
|------|--------------------|
| **Fast, one‑click booking** | Google Flights, Skyscanner, Kayak |
| **Lowest price, flexible dates** | Skyscanner, Momondo, Hopper |
| **Package deals (flight + hotel)** | Expedia, Priceline, Orbitz |
| **Corporate travel** | Concur, Egencia, Amadeus |
| **Developer integration** | Amadeus, Skyscanner, Sabre |
| **Real‑time flight status** | FlightAware, FlightRadar24 |
| **Travel agency workflow** | Sabre, Amadeus, Travelport |
| **Mobile‑first** | Hopper, Skyscanner, Google Flights |

---

#### Quick Tips

1. **Use multiple aggregators** – Prices can vary between sites; a quick cross‑check often reveals a better fare.
2. **Set price alerts** – Most aggregators (Google Flights, Skyscanner, Hopper) let you track a route and notify you when prices drop.
3. **Check airline direct** – After finding a fare, compare the same ticket on the airline’s own site; sometimes they offer lower fares or better seat selection.
4. **Consider “hidden‑city” booking** (if you’re comfortable with the risks) – Skiplagged can find cheaper fares by booking a flight that has a layover at your destination.
5. **Leverage loyalty programs** – If you fly frequently, book directly with the airline to accrue miles or points.

Feel free to let me know if you’d like deeper dives into any specific platform, API documentation, or how to integrate a particular tool into your own application!
